notes.title: Steam Deck™ Verified!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/dd295e654ed1f1f902b875fa6e457c4fa4cfc836.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

Good news: We have updated [i]Critadel[/i] to fully support the Steam Deck™! Now you can play [i]Critadel[/i] on the go, anywhere and anytime. With the Steam Deck controls, it plays just as you would play it with a controller on your PC.

Here are some of the key changes that were made to accommodate the Steam Deck hardware:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that caused the game to stutter when a player uses the volume buttons on Steam Deck
[*] Addressed the issue of text legibility by adding a Text Font Size Adjustment option (press the “hamburger” icon button on the Steam Deck -> select the “cog” icon -> adjust the bar next to “Language,” above “Confirm Button”) 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/b6a58f0053c482e19e1637ceec2ad4982289b124.png[/img]
Note: With this patch installed, the game will auto-detect when a controller is connected to your PC and force the game into “controller” mode. If you want to play with a keyboard and mouse, simply disconnect your controller.
We wish you all good luck as you progress through the tower, and good hunting!

notes.title: Critadel - Major Update 1.1.007 Patchnote
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the release of the major Critadel update that we revealed last month!

As we mentioned in the previous post, this update will add features and fixes that can enhance your gameplay experience in general.

The new update adds the following features:
- Weapon slot configuration
- Key rebinding
- Item descriptions
- Weapon auto-swap
- Improved weapon list UI
- New weapon change hotkey for controllers (default: LT(L2)+RS) 

We also implemented small balancings and fixes:
- Changed the color of the bubbles from the slime-like enemies to red for better visibility
- Increased the amount of experience points earned from Hard Mode (50% more than Normal Mode)
- Adjusted the trigger requirement of the third option for Ancient Storage Box (from "200 MAX HP decrease" to "100 MAX HP decrease")
- The disposer machine at Eve's shop will now dispense bigger crystals when you dispose of items ranked "A" or "S"
- Changed how players can move to the next room after defeating Longinus and Noah Fortress (players must now interact with the portal)
- Adjusted locations of light bulbs for some stages 

That should be it for this update! We hope these changes will make Critadel even more fun to play for you!

Also, happy Lunar New Year to everyone! 2022 is the year of the tiger, according to the Chinese zodiac, so here's Nox celebrating the new year with a tiger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/e1e22f748c37733c2ab382c9107be2b8e4c75500.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support. We'll be back again with some more information to share soon.

notes.title: Critadel - What’s Coming Next?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s already been a month since [b]Critadel[/b] was released. Thank you so much for all your support! We are sincerely happy to see everyone enjoying the game we worked so hard to create.

For the past few weeks, we’ve been pushing out patches for fixing bugs, re-balancing and quality-of-life improvements that needed our immediate attention. We'll keep an eye out for any additional bugs and fix them as soon as we can.

We are also working on bigger updates that will bring even greater QoL improvements based on your feedback, as well as a content update! Here's what we have planned so far:

[b]New Upcoming Features[/b]:
- Weapon Slot Configuration: You won’t have to drop your weapons to change their slot order!
- Key Rebinding: New options for both keyboard/mouse and controllers
- Item Descriptions: Pop-ups to identify items on the ground
- Weapon Auto-Swap: When your current weapon’s durability becomes 0, your character will switch to another available weapon in the next slot
- Weapon List UI: The weapon scroll list UI on the right side of the screen will be transparent for better gameplay visibility.


[b]New Contents[/b]:
- New Weapons / Attachments / Artifacts / Companions!
- Additional contents for Hard Mode

There are smaller improvements planned, too. We'll share more information about this update as we make more progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/76d1dd1b6bc1ab6449e169e5001ce9a4e98e56d6.png[/img]

Thanks again for all your support and feedback! We will see you soon.

notes.title: Critadel - Balance Patch 1.1.004 Patchnote
notes.notes:
[b]Re-balancing[/b]
- Changed a mechanic on Lilith: Now her bubbles will not protect her and won't cause her to be knocked out when destroyed.
- Fist Guardian: Removed the invincible barriers from his fists. Now only his torso is a hittable target.
- Decreased all bosses' health pool.
- Changed a damage values on some weapons. Many A-Ranked weapons that were underperforming have been buffed.
- Increased durability by 500 on all weapons.
- Decreased freeze effect time.
- Now a character won't get a damage from falling after clearing a room.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Fixed text overflow issues

notes.title: Critadel - Hotfix 1.1.003 Patchnote
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed Machine Leg effect bug which never disappeared from the screen.
- Fixed weapons that weren’t getting an effect of glancing blows properly (ex: Incisor, Heat Index)
- Fixed a bug which a player could get stuck behind a closed door or a wall.
- Fixed a bug which a player could get a damage from remaining projectiles that a boss shot even after the boss is defeated.
- Fixed a crash that was caused by obtaining Golden Frog.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Added a new repair kit which repairs all weapons in your inventory. It will only spawn with low-chance after defeating a boss. It does not spawn at regular rooms.
- Adjusted some weapon stats and their upgrade efficiency.
- Adjusted some stats of synergy effects.
- Adjusted some of the bosses’ health and damage.
- Changed some of the attack patterns of Duke. He will now only blocks attacks from his front when his shield is raised. His invincible barrier has been removed.
- Changed a behavior of projectiles from a player so that destructible objects (crates, weapon stands, light bulbs etc.) won’t block the projectiles. The barricades and bunkers still block projectiles.

notes.title: Critadel - Characters
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you had some fun with [b]Critadel[/b]’s Steam Next Fest demo!

It's been a while since we posted fun stuffs about [b]Critadel[/b]. Since the release date is tomorrow (yes, only one day left!), we would like to cover probably one of the most important aspects of the game before you start to play it.


[b]Characters[/b]

In Critadel, there are three unique characters you can play. If you played the Steam Next Fest demo, you had a chance to play as Nox. In the full version of the game, you'll be able to unlock two more characters by spending 10 soul orbs for each. Let’s go over them and see what they’ve got.


[b]Nox - Fearless Fighter[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/c25be6cb1ccd2cf74d5e6a6342487fc73cdcfb45.png[/img]

Nox is a member of the resistance against the Order of Noah. She came to the Tower of Babel to search and destroy the source of the evil cult's power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/c272914b303b8863715b9b188f066f345078eb54.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/6cfda392b3394fb82d7af331e2568b1f8b9725e7.png[/img]

She starts her journey with her Crewgun and Red Scarf.
The Crewgun is a very reliable weapon with a high rate of fire. As you can see from the description above, the weapon is both "normal" and "rifle" type. This means that you'll have a bit of an easier time fulfilling the normal and rifle type synergies, since you start with both types with this weapon.

The Red Scarf gives a +40 boost to your Maximum SP (Stamina Point), which is used when your character dodge-rolls. This allows Nox to perform one more consecutive dodge roll than other characters can from the start.

Based on this equipment, we can see that Nox is mainly focused on high SP and Normal or Rifle type weapons. Her multiple weapon types and extra dodge roll will allow you to build her up to be an agile fighter with constant damage output based on high rate of fire.


[b]Alice - Combat Android[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/092acb54f8ae704d9ff2460a81c20e267da81c38.png[/img]

Alice is a combat android made by an ancient civilization - the same one that also built the Tower of Babel. She is programmed to guard the tower from invaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/cb6b592382aad933008e63a91c07babd356e7468.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/4dfcbf3456c2cd860fb1889043187b6b8303c7db.png[/img]

Alice’s starting items are a Pulse Shotgun and the Pulse Core.
The Pulse Shotgun, as the name suggests, has a short range but shoots several energy pellets on a single trigger, resulting in high damage output. It has shotgun/energy type, so finding other weapons with those synergies will make your run a bit easier.

Pulse Core grants Alice a single shield point. In [b]Critadel[/b], shield can negate incoming damage regardless of how powerful the enemy's attack is. But as soon as it blocks a single attack, it disappears and can be only charged when you move to the next room (under normal circumstances).
 
If you like fast-paced combat with enemies up close and personal, Alice will be a good choice. Her focus on shotgun and energy types will help you fulfill synergies that grant higher damage multipliers, while her shield focus will make you play her in a different way from other characters.


[b]Ahnushu - Force of Nature[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/e8a6c15239be9f779d20125f2164b236d0a342db.png[/img]

Ahnushu is a warrior from the nature-worshipping cult called "Oracle." He came to the tower seeking the ancient knowledge that the Order of Noah is said to possess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/e103ee72788cc3d549c69b31bb179ba5c6f25554.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/7a8f87927fb0b0c36c545626c9f0550dbc73310a.png[/img]

Ahnushu starts with his Natura weapon and Symbol of Oracle.
Natura is a nature/charge type weapon with high alpha damage. Yes, it takes time to charge it up... but the damage from a single projectile is several times higher than other characters’ weapons!

Symbol of Oracle gives Ahnushu a +20 max AP (Ammunition Point) boost. This allows him to use his weapons longer without reloading them to recharge AP.

These starting items make Ahnushu more suitable for players who like to distance themselves from enemies and shoot them down before they get too close. Think of him as a sniper! If you can earn enough upgrades to his weapon stats, he'll be a "one-shot, one-kill" character.


[b]Character Skills[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/86c09251546a1737ba87ae6a742077291c268292.png[/img]

In [b]Critadel[/b], each character has their own set of skills they can use to maximize their potential. As you start to gain experience points from your runs, your characters will level up and new skills will be unlocked. You can equip up to five skills to customize your character; the first one never changes, nor can it be unequipped!

After you start to unlock new character skills, you'll find that each character’s unique skills are very focused on enhancing their existing special abilities. This will surely affect your runs, so we strongly suggest that you try to figure it out on your own!

That's it for today’s Steam post! We'll see you again tomorrow, [b]October 13 at 11:00 AM PDT[/b]!

notes.title: Critadel - Synergy
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and welcome back for the second weekly post about Critadel!

This week we'll take a look at one of the key game mechanics in Critadel: It's called Synergy.

As you make your way to the top of the tower, you will find all different kinds of weapons with different attributes. Let’s say you've picked up these weapons and saved them in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/75c25f11b94fa7323d8689aa01e80488181f4fbd.png[/img]

Please take a closer look at the colored icons under each weapon. As described in the previous post, these icons represent the weapon “types.” What’s important here is how many weapons you have in your inventory with matching types. For example, do you see the gold icon with three bullets? That's the "Rifle" type. In this inventory screen shot, there are six weapons with that type. Now let’s take a look at the synergy list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/a4d32aaa39747f38d0cce111381e4eac08e9d960.png[/img]

As you can see, each type has different effects. For example, the "Rifle" type synergy gives a rate-of-fire buff, while the "Charge" type synergy gives a reduced-charging-time bonus. Notice how “300%” with the number 6 next to it is highlighted. This means that your character has six weapons with “Rifle” type attached, so all of them will be able to 300% faster. Yes, 300%! To illustrate how big the difference is, here's a comparison:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/fea816976dadbbe0b4b017385570707d180893c6.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/18e6ad092ad8bdd300733a5d7d65771e58b300d8.gif[/img]

With this in mind, you can seek out and collect a certain number of the same type weapons to trigger some powerful synergy buffs. These buffs are very important, because they can raise your weapon’s power beyond the limits of its own stats and effects from attachments or artifacts. Of course, you can stack all the effects of attachments, artifacts and synergies, too!

There are many more synergies in Critadel than the ones listed above. It's a lot of fun to find great synergy combos to max out your weapons' power... and you will definitely want to do so, as the enemies in the tower get stronger and stronger on each floor!

That'll wrap up our post for today, but we have some big Critadel news coming very soon. Please look forward to it, and we'll see you with the next post!

notes.title: Critadel - Weapons, Attachments & Items
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the first of our weekly [b]Critadel[/b] posts!

Today we'd like to introduce you to some of the various items in [b]Critadel[/b]. There are three different kinds: weapons, attachments and artifacts. Let's take a closer look and see how they work.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/9c726036e7a5204909401af00c763e3ba71d1631.png[/img]

In [b]Critadel,[/b] there are number of different weapons to discover. Each weapon has a letter rank, either B, A or S. As you may have guessed, S-rank weapons will be better than weapons in the A group, and A is better than B. Each weapon is also very unique, and we're certain that you'll have a lot of fun playing around with them. Here are some examples of the weapons you will find in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/5200971bc49300c56de5e606b156ead5c8348f3c.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/067f002065c096c8a718368245ce00db60a36b20.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/1e819000aba42eac99f0fc3273e2f1e10ddff8b1.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/0401774676b63ee6547789b65d144f84cb673f0e.gif[/img]

In addition to the rank, each weapon description includes a type such as "Normal," "Rifle," "Burn," etc. The weapon type tells you how the weapon functions. Does the description indicate that your weapon is a "Rifle" type? Then you can go full-auto by holding the Fire button down. Is your weapon an "Explosive" type? If so, its projectiles will go "Ka-boom"! How about "Burn" type? That means your weapon's projectiles will ignite enemies and burn them alive. It's kind of like the "elemental" powers that you usually see in fantasy games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/0702c54abec42ac9e5d4bc2e7fbcfc6e748ee227.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/d3014fe2743123f3922d76b2b7a58a906fc91852.png[/img]

Interestingly enough, when you carry a certain number of weapons with the same type in your inventory, you will get special "Synergy" effects from them. We'll explain Synergies later, in another weekly post.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/55d879d3413b8eb2b79e54f9d38979a4f6feb5f9.png[/img]

With numerous different weapons in the game, there are plenty of different ways to attack your enemies. But on top of that, you can also upgrade and/or modify your weapons with 50 different attachments! Some of the attachments have simple effects, like "Increased damage"... but there are also more advanced attachments, like "Add a special snowball projectile that will freeze enemies and also add Freeze type to the weapon"! So you should always consider adding attachments to make sure your weapons can reach their full potential. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/0be70951921954d482dc6367ed6d9f3830ae1a56.png[/img]

There is a catch, though! You can add only two attachments to the same weapon, and if you ever want to detach one of them for any reason, you'll have to pay a small fee.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/4f4c01b54d52be084158a50de6bd4ab5cce8a572.png[/img]

Lastly, we have special items called "artifacts." Artifacts will give your character or your weapons certain enhancements. Some will add functionality to your weapons beyond what the attachments can do, while others directly enhance your character's abilities. Equipping an artifact might give a boost to your weapons’ magazine sizes, or even give your character the ability to shoot through barricades! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/7c7932e139083cc86f34f9854c91ed56a22f8632.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/9164cf1cd919da40c7f7439faab3f1271451baca.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/b03fcaeec8956a7ac03d8c1c8f6c3ee6b65c3d4e.png[/img]

Something to note about artifacts is that you cannot unequip them once you have obtained them. Their effects will remain active until the end of your current run. This also applies to debuff artifacts (yes, there are artifacts with negative effects!), so you'll have to think carefully before you pick them up.


There's so much more to say, but that should be it for this post. Look for more information in the coming weeks. In the next post, we'll talk about Synergy effects that will make your adventure to the top of Babel more interesting and fun....

notes.title: Announcing CRITADEL, coming in Q4 2021!
notes.notes:
“What is [b]Critadel[/b],” you ask? Take a peek at this trailer to find out: 

[previewyoutube=xJDwXoeN1mk;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/808010/Critadel/

Developed by Pixelian Studio from Korea, [b]Critadel[/b] is a brand-new futuristic 2D platform/shooter game with roguelike concepts and procedurally generated levels. It's a very unique experience, compared to other 2D roguelikes, and here are some of the reasons why:


[b]3 Unique Playable Characters[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/c25be6cb1ccd2cf74d5e6a6342487fc73cdcfb45.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/092acb54f8ae704d9ff2460a81c20e267da81c38.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/e8a6c15239be9f779d20125f2164b236d0a342db.png[/img]

There are three distinctive playable characters in [b]Critadel[/b], each with specialized skillsets, different starting weapons and unique abilities. You'll have to modify your approach depending on which one you choose and which of their skills you equip. Whenever you want to change it up and try to attack the game a different way, just choose a different character with a different loadout and see if they're a better match for your playing style.


[b]Branching Paths [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/01dabfac9b97787a8a462331c5385d9eed58c0c7.png[/img]

The ultimate goal of [b]Critadel[/b] is to find out what secret is hidden at the top of the tower. As you progress toward the top, you will encounter these branching paths every time you move to the next room. Each run can be very different, with new areas, new enemies and new bosses coming at you every time. The choice is yours, but remember: Once you select a path, you won’t be able to turn back!


[b]Weapons, Attachments and Artifacts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/e472f707888df0167bf039e216830572d908f887.png[/img]

Ah, yes! A game like [b]Critadel[/b] depends on powerful pew-pews, lots of crazy explosions and some mysterious buffs/nerfs. There are 200+ weapons, 50+ attachments and 300+ artifacts to discover, and each one has unique characteristics. With luck and skill, you might discover the perfect weapon/attachment/artifact combo that will destroy anything in your path, regardless of how strong the enemies are.


[b]Synergy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/ab4af72ed9f2783915156bf9ea03e73b6c89e6ae.png[/img]

The powerful items are all good, but you may want to plan what you'll carry throughout your run to make your character even stronger with Synergy effects. By meeting certain conditions and item combos, you'll be able to utilize powerful synergies with effects like increased firing rates and damage multipliers!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031348/8268fa40da3b930e52a59d587e81eebc1ee0d404.png[/img]


We'll post more detailed information about [b]Critadel[/b] in the upcoming weeks and give you a better idea of what you can expect from this fun game. We'll also have some exciting news to share very soon, so stay tuned by wishlisting [b]Critadel[/b], following us on [url=https://twitter.com/nicalis]Twitter[/url] or even subscribing to our [url=bit.ly/2LQAHSg]newsletter[/url]!
